stories.headline: John Goodman, 74, Looks Unrecognizable After 200-Pound Weight Loss in New Photo - E! News
stories.summary: John Goodman was nearly unrecognizable in a new picture with Wizards of Waverly Place actor David DeLuise due to the 200-pound weight loss transformation he’s undergone since the aughts.
stories.why: John Goodman's 200-pound transformation at 74 is culturally significant because it challenges the invisibility of aging men in entertainment and resets what late-career relevance looks like.
